items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I picked up and left him... Yellow left him. Rag Stevens, he left him. He practically lost all these men... I played the corner.

ctx.x: That was a pretty good band. All that thing, Gumjaw, got kind of crazy. And, uh, you start to beat up, Ed, you never can hear of a trombone player leading a band. You want to be the leader, you want to be this, and you want to be that, so, I picked up and left him. Yellow left him. Rag Stevens, he left him. He practically lost all these men. You had, he wound up with, uh, the trombone, the guitar, and the bass player. Joe Kazardt was the originator of the police minstrels. Joe could sing. I always used to kid…
One of them in there, I'm sure. Two of them. We've got plenty of hands, though.
